title: Data race in UpdateWithStart: ExecutionState read after releasing workflow lock
assumption: Assumed reading ExecutionState.Status after invoking workflowLease.GetReleaseFn() was thread-safe.
trigger: Concurrent API call (e.g. signal, terminate, update) acquiring workflow lock immediately after lease release.
observedFailure: Data race detected under Go race detector due to unsynchronized read/write of ExecutionState.Status.
fix: Captured ExecutionState.Status into local variable prior to calling workflowLease.GetReleaseFn().

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts no data race occurs under -race when concurrent goroutine modifies execution status.

generalizedConstraint: Captured ExecutionState.Status into local variable prior to calling workflowLease.GetReleaseFn().

title: Activity timer regeneration storm across replicated retries
assumption: Assumed activity attempt and stamp increments required blanket recreation of all four timer task types.
trigger: High-attempt activity retry loop under active-passive replication where schedule-to-close deadline remained invariant.
observedFailure: Generated over 240,000 duplicate ActivityTimeoutTasks with identical VisibilityTimestamp piling onto a single instant in timer queue.
fix: Refactored timer regeneration to calculate exact changedMask across 4 deadlines, preserving unchanged timer task status bits.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts schedule-to-close timer task status is preserved during activity retries when deadline does not move.

generalizedConstraint: Refactored timer regeneration to calculate exact changedMask across 4 deadlines, preserving unchanged timer task status bits.

title: CHASM PollComponent stall when shard moves off host
assumption: Assumed request context deadline was sufficient to unblock polling when shard ownership migrated.
trigger: Shard unloaded or reassigned to a different history host while a PollComponent request was long-polling.
observedFailure: Client blocked waiting until request timeout instead of immediately returning ShardOwnershipLostError for rapid redirect.
fix: Added select case on shard lifecycle context in PollComponent to immediately abort with ShardOwnershipLostError.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts long-poll returns immediately with ShardOwnershipLostError when shard context is canceled.

generalizedConstraint: Added select case on shard lifecycle context in PollComponent to immediately abort with ShardOwnershipLostError.

title: ForkHistoryBranch token divergence between persistence storage and history service
assumption: Assumed storage layer never modified base branch tokens during branch forking.
trigger: ForkHistoryBranch called on storage implementations that augment branch token metadata.
observedFailure: History service retained old branch token while storage operated on modified token, causing divergence during reset.
fix: Returned BaseBranchToken in ForkHistoryBranchResponse and updated resetters to rebuild using the returned token.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts history reset correctly falls back to caller token when BaseBranchToken is nil.

generalizedConstraint: Returned BaseBranchToken in ForkHistoryBranchResponse and updated resetters to rebuild using the returned token.

title: History pagination on stale branch token following multi-cluster conflict resolution
assumption: Assumed pagination tokens remained valid across asynchronous branch switches in multi-cluster setup.
trigger: Client paginating history while an active-passive failover and NDC conflict resolution reset the branch.
observedFailure: Pagination read history from an abandoned/orphaned branch rather than the active history branch.
fix: Added validation of pagination branch token against current mutable state branch token in GetWorkflowExecutionHistory.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts branch token validation accurately identifies token mismatches against execution state.

generalizedConstraint: Added validation of pagination branch token against current mutable state branch token in GetWorkflowExecutionHistory.

title: Read and ack levels moving backwards in matching priTaskReader
assumption: Assumed task slice iteration would strictly advance watermark without backward resets under empty slices.
trigger: Multiple readers concurrently loading tasks from multi-cursor queues with interleaved ack notifications.
observedFailure: Ack level moved backwards, causing duplicate task loads and redundant queue polling.
fix: Enforced monotonic advancement invariant on read and ack watermarks in priTaskReader.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts task reader ack level strictly never regresses below previously reported watermark.

generalizedConstraint: Enforced monotonic advancement invariant on read and ack watermarks in priTaskReader.

title: Data race in queue AppendSlices from reading slice tail without mutex lock
assumption: Assumed reading slice tail pointer was atomic with concurrent append operations.
trigger: Queue monitor evaluating slice predicates while reader group appended new task slices.
observedFailure: Data race condition detected between queue monitor and slice manager.
fix: Acquired reader lock prior to inspecting slice tail elements in AppendSlices.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts slice append and tail inspection execute without race detection warnings.

generalizedConstraint: Acquired reader lock prior to inspecting slice tail elements in AppendSlices.

title: SequentialScheduler test deadlock from bounded channel buffer exhaustion
assumption: Assumed task submission in tests would always be drained before exceeding fixed buffer size.
trigger: Submitting burst of sequential tasks when worker scheduler goroutines were blocked or delayed.
observedFailure: Test execution deadlocked indefinitely waiting on task submission channel.
fix: Dynamic queue sizing and non-blocking submission handshakes in SequentialScheduler tests.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts task scheduler successfully submits and executes sequential tasks.

generalizedConstraint: Dynamic queue sizing and non-blocking submission handshakes in SequentialScheduler tests.

title: Lost Activity Retry Timer Across Multi-Cluster Domain Failover
assumption: Assumed that timer tasks would naturally trigger activity retries in whichever cluster is active, or that timeout tasks would suffice.
trigger: An activity failed retriably with exponential backoff on cluster A, and domain failover switched the active cluster to cluster B before the backoff timer elapsed.
observedFailure: Timer tasks are local to the cluster where they were generated and are not replicated. Cluster A's standby timer executor discarded/acked the local ActivityRetryTimerTask upon becoming standby, while cluster B applied SyncActivity without generating an ActivityRetryTimerTask. The activity retry remained stuck in SCHEDULED state until ScheduleToStart timeout expired (potentially days/weeks later).
fix: Modified SyncActivity handler in activityReplicator to explicitly inspect unstarted retries (startedID == EmptyEventID and attempt > localAttempt) and generate an ActivityRetryTimerTask on the newly active cluster.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that SyncActivity generates an ActivityRetryTimerTask on the target cluster when startedID is empty and incoming attempt is greater than local attempt.

generalizedConstraint: Modified SyncActivity handler in activityReplicator to explicitly inspect unstarted retries (startedID == EmptyEventID and attempt > localAttempt) and generate an ActivityRetryTimerTask on the newly active cluster.

title: History Event Corruption from Duplicate Buffered Events During Flush
assumption: Assumed that event deduplication in mutable_state_builder only needed to guard against duplicate ActivityTask events during buffered event flushing.
trigger: A decision task was in flight while external events (child workflow termination, cancel requests, external signals) were delivered multiple times due to persistence retries or concurrent calls.
observedFailure: Duplicate events for child workflows or external signals were appended to history upon decision task completion, violating sequence invariants and leading to corrupted workflow history.
fix: Generalized reorderAndFilterDuplicateEvents in mutableStateBuilder to track uniqueness across all event types that reference an initiated/scheduled event ID (child workflow, cancel requests, signals) using a comprehensive bufferedUniqueEvents map.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that duplicate child workflow terminated, cancel requested, and external signal events in bufferedEvents are deduplicated and logged before flush.

generalizedConstraint: Generalized reorderAndFilterDuplicateEvents in mutableStateBuilder to track uniqueness across all event types that reference an initiated/scheduled event ID (child workflow, cancel requests, signals) using a comprehensive bufferedUniqueEvents map.

title: Stale Cached Queue Reader State Across Shard RangeID Changes
assumption: Assumed in-memory cached queue reader buffers remained valid across shard range renewals on the same host.
trigger: History host renewed shard RangeID or reloaded shard after temporary network disconnection.
observedFailure: CachedQueueReader contained task records from the previous RangeID generation, causing stale task execution or sequence misalignment.
fix: Added hook to invalidate and clear CachedQueueReader cache immediately whenever shard RangeID changes by >1.
changedFilesNotes: In subsequent refactorings (#8456, #8462), queue_reader_cached.go was split into queue_reader_cached_base.go and queue_reader_cached_scheduled.go, and queue_reader_cached_test.go was renamed to queue_reader_cached_scheduled_test.go.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that when shard RangeID increments by >1, GetTask clears in-memory cache and falls back to base persistence reader.

generalizedConstraint: Added hook to invalidate and clear CachedQueueReader cache immediately whenever shard RangeID changes by >1.

title: Cassandra LWT Conditional Batch Disambiguation on Semaphore Grants
assumption: Assumed boolean applied/not-applied from Cassandra Lightweight Transactions (LWT) was sufficient to handle semaphore token acquisition.
trigger: Multiple concurrent workers attempted to acquire semaphore tokens simultaneously.
observedFailure: When a conditional batch failed, callers could not distinguish between 'token already held by this caller (idempotent reuse)' versus 'token taken by a competitor'.
fix: Implemented full multi-row CAS inspection in Cassandra NoSQL plugin walking returned rows to inspect owner ID and disambiguate ownership reuse from contention.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that GrantSemaphoreToken evaluates CAS conditional batch results and correctly disambiguates SemaphoreGrantApplied, SemaphoreGrantSlotTaken, and SemaphoreGrantAlreadyHeld outcomes.

generalizedConstraint: Implemented full multi-row CAS inspection in Cassandra NoSQL plugin walking returned rows to inspect owner ID and disambiguate ownership reuse from contention.

title: History Invalid and Mismatched Current Execution Record Corruption
assumption: Assumed concrete workflow executions and 'current execution' pointer records in persistence never drift out of sync.
trigger: Partial writes, storage split-brain, or aborted run creations leaving dangling current records or corrupted first event references.
observedFailure: Current execution table pointed to non-existent or corrupted workflow runIDs, blocking workflow reuse for the same WorkflowID.
fix: Introduced reconciliation invariants (HistoryInvalid and MismatchedRecords) to detect corrupted first event IDs and clean up orphaned current execution pointers safely.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that mismatched current execution records pointing to invalid or non-matching concrete workflow runs are flagged as corrupt.

generalizedConstraint: Introduced reconciliation invariants (HistoryInvalid and MismatchedRecords) to detect corrupted first event IDs and clean up orphaned current execution pointers safely.

title: Race Condition Between AsyncSystemTaskExecutor and WorkflowRepairService
assumption: Assumed that removing an asynchronous system task from the queue before updating its execution status in DAO was safe.
trigger: An asynchronous system task (e.g. SUB_WORKFLOW or HTTP) started execution while WorkflowRepairService inspected the workflow.
observedFailure: WorkflowRepairService observed the task in SCHEDULED status in DAO but missing from queueDAO, concluded the queue message was lost, and re-pushed the task, resulting in duplicate concurrent execution of sub-workflows or HTTP tasks.
fix: Modified AsyncSystemTaskExecutor to persist updated task status in ExecutionDAOFacade before removing the message from QueueDAO.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that WorkflowRepairService correctly inspects async system task status and does not generate duplicate queue messages for active tasks.

generalizedConstraint: Modified AsyncSystemTaskExecutor to persist updated task status in ExecutionDAOFacade before removing the message from QueueDAO.

title: Orphaned Event Handler Index on Event Name Mutation
assumption: Assumed updating an event handler in Redis only required overwriting the handler definition record by name.
trigger: An existing event handler definition was updated with a new target event topic.
observedFailure: The previous event name index set in Redis retained the handler reference, causing events on the old topic to continue triggering the updated event handler.
fix: Explicitly remove previous index references in RedisEventHandlerDAO when the event name changes during updateEventHandler.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that event handler updates correctly remove stale index entries and update active event subscriptions.

generalizedConstraint: Explicitly remove previous index references in RedisEventHandlerDAO when the event name changes during updateEventHandler.

title: Deadlock on Nested Execution Lock Acquisition in LocalOnlyLock
assumption: Assumed workflow execution locks were only acquired once per thread per top-level workflow evaluation.
trigger: A task update threw TerminateWorkflowException or invoked nested workflow operations that re-acquired the workflow lock on the same thread.
observedFailure: LocalOnlyLock did not support reentrancy, causing self-deadlock on worker execution threads.
fix: Refactored LocalOnlyLock using ReentrantLock semantics tracking thread ownership and hold counts.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that LocalOnlyLock allows reentrant lock acquisitions on the same thread without deadlocking.

generalizedConstraint: Refactored LocalOnlyLock using ReentrantLock semantics tracking thread ownership and hold counts.

title: Disappearing Intermediate Output Data on Long-Running Tasks with External Payload Storage
assumption: Assumed merging externalized payload output with in-memory task output was commutative.
trigger: A long-running task (e.g. JOIN task collecting forked outputs) grew its output over multiple decider evaluation cycles with external payload storage enabled.
observedFailure: During externalization/internalization cycles, stale outputPayload from external storage overwrote newer in-memory outputData, discarding computed outputs.
fix: Preserved in-memory outputData as authoritative over stale external payload references during task model serialization.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that DeciderService correctly preserves task outputs across iterative evaluation cycles.

generalizedConstraint: Preserved in-memory outputData as authoritative over stale external payload references during task model serialization.

title: HTTP Task Hang from Null Pointer Exception in DummyPayloadStorage
assumption: Assumed DummyPayloadStorage.downloadPayload could return null or in-memory streams without path validation.
trigger: An HTTP task with externalized payloads attempted to download payloads under test or dummy storage configurations.
observedFailure: NullPointerException during payload retrieval caused HTTP task executor to abort without updating task status, hanging the task indefinitely.
fix: Added robust path resolution, stream buffering, and error handling in DummyPayloadStorage.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that DummyPayloadStorage retrieves valid payload input streams without throwing NullPointerException.

generalizedConstraint: Added robust path resolution, stream buffering, and error handling in DummyPayloadStorage.

title: Row Locking and Terminal State Revalidation in Heartbeat-Timeout Zombie Purge
assumption: Assumed scanning running task instances without row locks before calling handle_failure() in a separate step was safe.
trigger: A task instance timed out on heartbeat in the scheduler scan while a worker concurrently committed task status as SUCCESS to the database.
observedFailure: handle_failure() refreshed the TI and unconditionally set FAILED, clobbering the worker's legitimate SUCCESS terminal state and dispatching false failure callbacks.
fix: Locked the heartbeat scan query with with_row_locks(of=TI, skip_locked=True) within the transaction, and added terminal state revalidation in the purge loop to skip tasks no longer in RUNNING/RESTARTING.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that the heartbeat timeout purge query acquires row locks with skip_locked to prevent race conditions with concurrent worker status updates.

generalizedConstraint: Locked the heartbeat scan query with with_row_locks(of=TI, skip_locked=True) within the transaction, and added terminal state revalidation in the purge loop to skip tasks no longer in RUNNING/RESTARTING.

title: Premature Task Termination on Deferrable Trigger TaskFailedEvent
assumption: Assumed a TaskFailedEvent yielded by an asynchronous trigger was always terminal and should immediately mark the task as FAILED.
trigger: A deferrable operator yielded to TriggererJobRunner, and the trigger encountered a transient failure and emitted TaskFailedEvent on a task with retries remaining.
observedFailure: The scheduler transitioned the task instance directly to FAILED and ran on_failure_callback, bypassing configured retry policies and aborting valid retry attempts.
fix: Updated Trigger.submit_event to inspect is_eligible_to_retry() on TaskFailedEvent and transition the task instance to UP_FOR_RETRY rather than FAILED.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that TaskFailedEvent from triggers respects task retry eligibility and sets state to UP_FOR_RETRY when retries remain.

generalizedConstraint: Updated Trigger.submit_event to inspect is_eligible_to_retry() on TaskFailedEvent and transition the task instance to UP_FOR_RETRY rather than FAILED.

title: Deadlock Prevention in Trigger.clean_unused via Row-Level Anti-Join Locking
assumption: Assumed cleaning orphaned trigger rows in the database across multiple triggerer pods could run uncoordinated without row locks.
trigger: Multiple concurrent triggerer pods ran Trigger.clean_unused() concurrently during high-churn deferral workloads.
observedFailure: Database lock contention and deadlocks occurred on relational databases, causing triggerer process crashes.
fix: Refactored Trigger.clean_unused to use a NOT EXISTS anti-join with with_row_locks(of=Trigger, skip_locked=True) so concurrent triggerers skip rows locked by other instances.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that Trigger.clean_unused safely purges orphaned trigger rows without locking active triggers or raising deadlocks.

generalizedConstraint: Refactored Trigger.clean_unused to use a NOT EXISTS anti-join with with_row_locks(of=Trigger, skip_locked=True) so concurrent triggerers skip rows locked by other instances.

title: Scheduler Linear Stall on Wide Dynamic Task Mapping Expansion
assumption: Assumed creating mapped task instances during DagRun.update_state with per-index session.merge() was sufficiently fast.
trigger: A dynamic task mapping operator expanded over an upstream XCom array with wide fan-out.
observedFailure: N+1 queries during expansion caused scheduler thread stalls scaling linearly with map width, blocking other active DAG runs.
fix: Replaced per-index session.merge() with batched session.add_all() / flush() and primed the dag_run relationship across all mapped instances in a single query.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that TaskMap.expand_mapped_task creates wide mapped task instances in a constant number of database queries with primed dag_run relationships.

generalizedConstraint: Replaced per-index session.merge() with batched session.add_all() / flush() and primed the dag_run relationship across all mapped instances in a single query.

title: Scheduler Callback Crash on Nullable DAG Version References
assumption: Assumed ti.dag_version was always non-null when dispatching scheduler failure or retry callbacks.
trigger: Tasks executed under unversioned or legacy DAG definitions were failed by the scheduler or timed out.
observedFailure: Scheduler crashed with AttributeError when constructing TaskCallbackRequest accessing ti.dag_version.bundle_name, halting scheduler execution loops.
fix: Added null checks and automatic backfilling via _ensure_ti_has_dag_version_id() with fallback to DagModel.bundle_name and DagRun.bundle_version.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that scheduler callback bundle info safely resolves bundle metadata even when dag_version is null.

generalizedConstraint: Added null checks and automatic backfilling via _ensure_ti_has_dag_version_id() with fallback to DagModel.bundle_name and DagRun.bundle_version.

title: Semaphore Capacity Leak on Limit Fetch Failure During Slot Release
assumption: Assumed releasing a synchronization semaphore slot required fetching the latest limit first before updating acquired slots.
trigger: A workflow step completed and attempted to release its semaphore slot when the ConfigMap limit fetch encountered a transient network error.
observedFailure: The release function aborted early without decrementing the holding key in the semaphore ConfigMap, permanently leaking semaphore capacity and blocking future workflow steps.
fix: Ensured semaphore release unconditionally removes the holder key from the acquired list before returning any error from limit retrieval.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that semaphore release successfully removes holding keys and frees slots even when limit fetch fails.

generalizedConstraint: Ensured semaphore release unconditionally removes the holder key from the acquired list before returning any error from limit retrieval.

title: Non-Deterministic Node Status Pruning on Workflow Retry Reset
assumption: Assumed deleting failed downstream nodes during workflow retry could traverse the node status map in arbitrary non-deterministic Go map iteration order.
trigger: A user retried a failed workflow containing nested DAGs and diamond dependencies with multiple retried nodes.
observedFailure: Non-deterministic map ordering resulted in inconsistently preserved node statuses and broken outbound dependency references across retry attempts.
fix: Sorted node IDs deterministically before deleting child/dependent nodes during workflow retry state reformulation.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that formulating a retry workflow resets node statuses in a deterministic, reproducible order.

generalizedConstraint: Sorted node IDs deterministically before deleting child/dependent nodes during workflow retry state reformulation.

title: Orphaned Running Retry Wrapper Node on Workflow Termination
assumption: Assumed terminating or stopping a workflow only needed to mark leaf pod nodes as failed.
trigger: A workflow was terminated or stopped (Shutdown: Terminate or Stop) while a node with a retry strategy was between retry attempts.
observedFailure: The retry wrapper node remained indefinitely in Running phase while all child pods were terminated, leaving the workflow in an inconsistent non-terminal state.
fix: Updated failNodesWithoutCreatedPodsAfterDeadlineOrShutdown to inspect NodeTypeRetry nodes whose active child pods have finished and mark the parent retry node as Failed.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that retry wrapper nodes are marked Failed with Terminate or Stop message when workflow is stopped during active retry.

generalizedConstraint: Updated failNodesWithoutCreatedPodsAfterDeadlineOrShutdown to inspect NodeTypeRetry nodes whose active child pods have finished and mark the parent retry node as Failed.

title: Duplicate Workflow Archive Invocations and Missing Retry on Failure
assumption: Assumed workflow archival could be triggered unconditionally in the controller reconciliation loop without idempotent archive tracking.
trigger: Workflows completed under high cluster load with slow external archive database connections, or archive errors occurred transiently.
observedFailure: Failed archive attempts were dropped without retry, while subsequent controller updates triggered duplicate redundant archive operations.
fix: Added a dedicated archive workqueue with exponential backoff retries and ensured each workflow is archived exactly once upon entering terminal phase.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that workflow archival runs exactly once per workflow and retries on transient archive errors.

generalizedConstraint: Added a dedicated archive workqueue with exponential backoff retries and ensured each workflow is archived exactly once upon entering terminal phase.

title: Semaphore Initialization Panic on Dynamically Resolved Zero Limit
assumption: Assumed synchronization semaphore limits configured via ConfigMaps or workflow variables were always strictly positive integers (> 0).
trigger: A semaphore limit evaluated dynamically to 0 (e.g. maintenance mode or disabled concurrency limit).
observedFailure: Semaphore creation failed or panicked with an invalid limit error, blocking workflow step initialization entirely.
fix: Allowed semaphore initialization with a resolved limit of 0, correctly treating it as 0 available capacity (all acquisition requests block or queue).

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that semaphores initialized with limit 0 correctly initialize without panic and deny acquisition.

generalizedConstraint: Allowed semaphore initialization with a resolved limit of 0, correctly treating it as 0 available capacity (all acquisition requests block or queue).

title: Deadlock in SqlPollingEventWatcher.close() During Callback Unwatch Re-entry
assumption: Assumed SqlPollingEventWatcher.close() could safely acquire _dict_lock and call join() on all active watcher threads while holding the lock.
trigger: A watcher thread fired an event callback outside the lock, which executed end_watch -> unwatch_run() attempting to acquire _dict_lock, while close() was concurrently holding _dict_lock and waiting to join() the watcher thread.
observedFailure: Teardown deadlock occurred where the main thread blocked forever in close(), causing test suite and daemon timeouts (>240s).
fix: Snapshot the watcher list and set should_thread_exit inside _dict_lock, clear the map, and call join() outside the lock so re-entrant unwatch_run() calls can complete.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that starting and ending event log watchers terminates watcher threads cleanly without hanging on close().

generalizedConstraint: Snapshot the watcher list and set should_thread_exit inside _dict_lock, clear the map, and call join() outside the lock so re-entrant unwatch_run() calls can complete.

title: Stale Pre-Wipe Materialization Returned by get_latest_materialization_event
assumption: Assumed reading cached asset materialization events from secondary index tables was always consistent with wiped asset event histories.
trigger: An asset's historical event log was wiped, and downstream execution or UI subsequently queried get_latest_materialization_event().
observedFailure: Query returned the stale cached pre-wipe materialization record instead of None, causing invalid downstream dependency evaluations and stale lineage data.
fix: Added validation to ensure cached materialization index rows verify against the latest event log wipe boundary timestamp before returning.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that get_latest_materialization_event ignores stale cached index records after an asset wipe.

generalizedConstraint: Added validation to ensure cached materialization index rows verify against the latest event log wipe boundary timestamp before returning.

title: Race Condition on Failure Reason Tag Visibility During Run Status Polling
assumption: Assumed updating run status to FAILURE and inserting RUN_FAILURE_REASON_TAG in two separate database transactions was safe.
trigger: A caller polled for run.is_finished, observed status=FAILURE, and immediately read run.tags.
observedFailure: Because the status UPDATE committed before the tag INSERT, the caller encountered KeyError: 'dagster/failure_reason' and misclassified the failure reason.
fix: Write the RunTagsTable row first before the RunsTable status update and include the tag in the serialized run_body.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that failure events write failure reason tags atomically alongside run failure status updates.

generalizedConstraint: Write the RunTagsTable row first before the RunsTable status update and include the tag in the serialized run_body.

title: Path Traversal Escape in Partition Key Storage Directory Resolution
assumption: Assumed partition key strings in UPathIOManager and FSIOManager could be appended directly to base directory paths.
trigger: Partition keys containing path separators or path operators (e.g. ../) were materialized.
observedFailure: Output files escaped the configured base storage directory, causing data corruption across partitions or filesystem permission errors.
fix: Added strict path escaping and traversal validation to ensure all partitioned output paths remain strictly inside the configured base directory.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that FSIOManager escapes path operators in partition keys and prevents escaping the base directory.

generalizedConstraint: Added strict path escaping and traversal validation to ensure all partitioned output paths remain strictly inside the configured base directory.

title: Sub-Microsecond Timestamp Precision Mismatch in Asset Data Time Calculation
assumption: Assumed Python datetime objects across event logs and asset daemon memory preserved microsecond precision identically across different database backends.
trigger: Auto-materialize policies evaluated data freshness timestamps stored in relational databases with varying fractional second precision.
observedFailure: Sub-microsecond precision differences produced false freshness comparisons, causing redundant asset re-evaluations or missed auto-materializations.
fix: Truncated sub-microsecond bits in CachingDataTimeResolver leaves to enforce uniform timestamp granularity across backends.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that asset data time calculation evaluates timestamp boundaries consistently across database backends.

generalizedConstraint: Truncated sub-microsecond bits in CachingDataTimeResolver leaves to enforce uniform timestamp granularity across backends.

title: Prevent duplicate Late state transitions in MarkLateRuns
assumption: Assumed MarkLateRuns service could safely propose Late state transitions without checking if flow run was already in Late state.
trigger: Multiple orchestrator passes or concurrent scheduler sweeps over scheduled flow runs past their start deadline.
observedFailure: Duplicate redundant Late state history entries and unnecessary state transition database writes.
fix: Added PreventDuplicateTransitions orchestration rule in CoreFlowPolicy rejecting duplicate Late transitions.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts orchestrator rejects state transition when flow run is already marked Late.

generalizedConstraint: Added PreventDuplicateTransitions orchestration rule in CoreFlowPolicy rejecting duplicate Late transitions.

title: ZeroDivisionError in RetryFailedTasks when retry_jitter_factor set without retry_delay
assumption: Assumed retry_delay was always positive when retry_jitter_factor was configured on task retries.
trigger: Task configured with retry_jitter_factor and retry_delay=0 (or unset) encountering a task failure.
observedFailure: ZeroDivisionError crashed the server-side state transition handler instead of transitioning task to AwaitingRetry.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts task retry orchestration does not raise ZeroDivisionError when retry delay is zero.

generalizedConstraint: Guarded jitter calculation against zero delay, defaulting jitter to 0.0 when delay is zero.

title: Subflow tracking dynamic key collisions across concurrent retry executions
assumption: Assumed task run index and subflow call parameters were unique and stable across concurrent subflow executions.
trigger: Concurrent or repeated subflows invoked inside tasks during retry loops.
observedFailure: Shared dynamic tracking keys collided in FlowRunEngine, causing subflows to return mismatched results or overwrite parent context.

generalizedConstraint: Generated unique UUID-based dynamic keys for async subflow invocations within task execution contexts.

title: PostgreSQL server transaction isolation level non-determinism
assumption: Assumed default SQLAlchemy engine isolation level was consistently READ COMMITTED across all PostgreSQL driver variants.
trigger: Contended concurrency limit slot acquisition and lock evaluations in PostgreSQL.
observedFailure: Inconsistent isolation levels led to serialization anomalies and dirty reads in concurrency limit slot evaluations.

generalizedConstraint: Explicitly enforced READ COMMITTED isolation level in PostgreSQL engine configuration.

title: Redis cluster hash-slot misalignment in distributed concurrency leases

generalizedConstraint: Added hashtag grouping ensuring all related keys hash to the same cluster slot.

title: Duplicate server-minted flow-run state timestamps breaking monotonic state ordering
assumption: Assumed rapid back-to-back state transitions in a single microsecond would always produce distinct timestamps.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts sequential state transitions minted within the same microsecond receive monotonically strictly increasing timestamps.

generalizedConstraint: Added unique timestamp collision resolution in global_policy.py adjusting colliding timestamps to nearest microsecond.

title: Watcher-thread timeout enforcer thread leak on scope exit
assumption: Assumed timeout watcher threads would terminate when cancellation scope was exited normally.
trigger: Running numerous short-lived tasks with timeout scopes in long-running worker processes.
observedFailure: Watcher threads leaked in memory, eventually exhausting system thread limits.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts watcher thread terminates properly upon scope teardown without leaking threads.

generalizedConstraint: Added explicit enforcer teardown and thread cleanup in cancellation scope context managers.

title: FileSystemLockManager hold timeout race condition
assumption: Assumed real system clock sleep intervals were deterministic in CI test runners.
trigger: High CPU contention in CI causing lock manager hold-timeout checks to fail due to timing jitter.
observedFailure: Flaky lock acquisition tests and race conditions when checking lock expiration.
fix: Injected deterministic mock clock fixture into FileSystemLockManager hold-timeout tests.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts lock manager hold-timeout correctly expires lock based on injected clock.

generalizedConstraint: Injected deterministic mock clock fixture into FileSystemLockManager hold-timeout tests.

title: Uncaught Nested SQL Deadlock Exceptions Causing Transaction Failures
assumption: Assumed SQL deadlock exceptions only occurred as immediate direct cause exceptions in database operations.
trigger: Concurrent execution state updates produced PostgreSQL/MySQL deadlocks wrapped two or more levels deep inside JDBC/jOOQ exception wrappers.
observedFailure: Deadlock detection predicate failed to match deeply nested deadlock exceptions, resulting in unhandled fatal errors instead of automated transaction retries.
fix: Enhanced JooqDSLContextWrapper deadlock predicate to recursively traverse exception cause chains and suppressed exceptions.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that JooqDSLContextWrapper recognizes deadlock SQLState error codes nested two levels deep in exception cause chains.

generalizedConstraint: Enhanced JooqDSLContextWrapper deadlock predicate to recursively traverse exception cause chains and suppressed exceptions.

title: Double Concurrency Slot Release on Subflow Killed by SLA
assumption: Assumed subflow termination handlers and parent SLA timeout handlers released flow concurrency slots independently without collision.
trigger: A parent flow with concurrency limits had a child subflow killed by an SLA timeout rule.
observedFailure: Both the SLA killer and subflow termination handler decremented the flow concurrency counter, causing the running counter to become corrupted / negative.
fix: Added concurrency slot release fencing to prevent duplicate decrement calls when a subflow execution is killed by SLA.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that killing a subflow via SLA returns the flow concurrency running counter back to exactly zero without double release.

generalizedConstraint: Added concurrency slot release fencing to prevent duplicate decrement calls when a subflow execution is killed by SLA.

title: Webhook Follow Execution Event Emitted Pre-Commit Causing Client Hang
assumption: Assumed emitting FollowExecutionEvent before database transaction commit was safe for downstream webhook listeners.
trigger: An execution failed and emitted termination events before the database transaction committed the final failure state.
observedFailure: Webhook clients with wait: true received the termination event, queried the database before the transaction committed, found the execution still running, and hung indefinitely.
fix: Moved FollowExecutionEvent emission to execute strictly post-commit in the executor failure path.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that streaming execution flux completes only after the terminated execution is persisted in the repository.

generalizedConstraint: Moved FollowExecutionEvent emission to execute strictly post-commit in the executor failure path.

title: Uncaught Exception in Loop Task When Iteration List Shrinks Dynamically
assumption: Assumed dynamic loop value lists never shrank in size between iteration evaluation cycles.
trigger: A dynamic Loop task evaluated an iteration where the input collection size became smaller than previously evaluated iteration indices.
observedFailure: Loop handler threw an unhandled IndexOutOfBoundsException, crashing the executor thread rather than failing only the execution cleanly.
fix: Added boundary check in LoopExecutionEventMessageHandler to catch iteration shrinkage and fail only the affected execution instance.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that shrinking loop values between iterations fails only the execution cleanly without crashing the executor.

generalizedConstraint: Added boundary check in LoopExecutionEventMessageHandler to catch iteration shrinkage and fail only the affected execution instance.

title: Arithmetic Overflow from Out-of-Range Duration Values in Retry Policies
assumption: Assumed user-supplied duration strings in retry and SLA configurations fit within standard integer millisecond ranges.
trigger: A flow definition specified extremely large retry interval durations (e.g. >10 years).
observedFailure: Duration calculation produced arithmetic overflow in time calculations, causing immediate unexpected retry execution or timer crashes.
fix: Added DurationMax annotation and validation to enforce bounds on user-supplied durations across retry, SLA, and time window configs.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that DurationMax validator rejects retry intervals greater than the maximum supported duration boundary.

generalizedConstraint: Added DurationMax annotation and validation to enforce bounds on user-supplied durations across retry, SLA, and time window configs.

title: Outbound Budget Deadlock in Invoker Stream Message Dispatch
assumption: Assumed holding stream buffer ownership across async writes in InvokerBody could not deadlock with concurrent budget releases.
trigger: An invoker task generated large outbound message frames while concurrent budget grants were waiting on stream buffer releases.
observedFailure: Invoker task deadlocked waiting on its own outbound budget allocation, stalling service protocol message delivery.
fix: Replaced InvokerBody with Bytes::from_owner to decouple buffer lifetime from lock ownership and prevent budget deadlocks.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that outbound stream message dispatching operates without deadlocking budget allocations.

generalizedConstraint: Replaced InvokerBody with Bytes::from_owner to decouple buffer lifetime from lock ownership and prevent budget deadlocks.

title: Race Condition During Bifrost Loglet Tail Repair Protocol
assumption: Assumed find-tail queries on replicated loglets observed monotonic tail offsets during concurrent cluster repairs.
trigger: A replica node participated in loglet tail repair while concurrent writes were advancing the active loglet tail.
observedFailure: find-tail encountered race conditions where uncommitted repair entries produced inconsistent tail offset calculations.
fix: Made find-tail logic resilient to concurrent repair races by validating quorum committed offsets before establishing tail positions.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that background appender flushes loglet entries cleanly without corrupted tail offset records.

generalizedConstraint: Made find-tail logic resilient to concurrent repair races by validating quorum committed offsets before establishing tail positions.

title: Infinite Retry Loops on Partition Processors with Sealed Storage Stores
assumption: Assumed failing partition stores should be retried continuously by partition processors.
trigger: A partition store was sealed due to partition migration or storage corruption.
observedFailure: Partition processor entered a tight CPU-spinning retry loop attempting to reopen the sealed store, exhausting worker CPU cycles.
fix: Parked partition processors encountering sealed stores instead of retrying, reporting clean status to cluster state manager.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that partition processor caches handle sealed states cleanly without spinning on retries.

generalizedConstraint: Parked partition processors encountering sealed stores instead of retrying, reporting clean status to cluster state manager.

title: Double Memory Clone Overhead on Partition Journal Entry Writes
assumption: Assumed cloning journal entries during write serialization had negligible overhead on write throughput.
trigger: High-throughput ingress workloads wrote millions of state journal entries per second.
observedFailure: Redundant memory copies in journal_table_v2 saturated allocator heap bandwidth and increased write latency.
fix: Refactored journal entry writing to take ownership of byte buffers, eliminating redundant cloning operations.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that journal entry writes track durable LSNs without redundant memory clones.

generalizedConstraint: Refactored journal entry writing to take ownership of byte buffers, eliminating redundant cloning operations.

title: Premature Timeout Abort in Ingress RPC Client Retries
assumption: Assumed strict short timeout retries were appropriate for all internal partition RPC dispatches.
trigger: Transient partition leader re-elections caused partition RPC responses to take slightly longer than initial retry limits.
observedFailure: Ingress clients aborted valid in-flight invocations prematurely, surfacing avoidable HTTP 500 errors to callers.
fix: Relaxed invocation client retry policy with exponential backoff and added granular RPC latency metrics.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that service handler applies configured delay and retry bounds before timing out RPC calls.

generalizedConstraint: Relaxed invocation client retry policy with exponential backoff and added granular RPC latency metrics.

title: Stale HTTP Trigger Cache Due to Sequence Number Advance Ahead of Commit
assumption: Assumed HTTP trigger sequence versions always advanced strictly after transaction commit.
trigger: An HTTP trigger row committed with its version sequence number advancing ahead of the cached version gate in memory.
observedFailure: Version gate skipped rebuilding the HTTP routing table, causing webhooks to return HTTP 404.
fix: Forced HTTP router cache rebuild on trigger change notifications and added explicit invalidation.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that forced refresh and cache invalidation rebuilds HTTP routes when sequence numbers advance ahead of cache.

generalizedConstraint: Forced HTTP router cache rebuild on trigger change notifications and added explicit invalidation.

title: Privilege Escalation from Unconfined Job Token Access to Instance API Routes
assumption: Assumed ephemeral job execution tokens were naturally restricted by endpoint permission checks.
trigger: A script job used its minted execution token to call instance-wide or cross-workspace API routes.
observedFailure: Job tokens could access administrative endpoints outside their assigned workspace.
fix: Enforced strict workspace confinement gates on all bearer tokens minted for job executions.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that job execution tokens are strictly confined to workspace-scoped API endpoints and rejected by instance gates.

generalizedConstraint: Enforced strict workspace confinement gates on all bearer tokens minted for job executions.

title: Missing Admin Gate on Workspace Settings Tarball Export
assumption: Assumed workspace tarball exports could be performed by any developer with read access.
trigger: A non-admin user initiated a workspace settings tarball export containing instance configurations.
observedFailure: Sensitive workspace settings were exported without admin authorization.
fix: Added require_admin authorization check on workspace settings export endpoints.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that workspace tarball settings export requires admin authorization.

generalizedConstraint: Added require_admin authorization check on workspace settings export endpoints.

title: Misattributed Zombie Flow OOM Diagnosis on Queue Workers
assumption: Assumed all zombie flow OOM terminations occurred on queue worker processes.
trigger: A complex flow step ran out of memory on transition workers during step-to-step state transitions.
observedFailure: Flow monitor attributed OOM failures to queue workers, misleading operators during debugging.
fix: Updated SQL monitor query to attribute zombie flow OOMs directly to transition worker processes.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that batch rerun handles completed and rerun script jobs cleanly.

generalizedConstraint: Updated SQL monitor query to attribute zombie flow OOMs directly to transition worker processes.

title: Lock Contention from Non-RLS Reads Inside Schedule Creation Transactions
assumption: Assumed executing non-RLS database queries inside schedule creation transactions had no concurrency impact.
trigger: Concurrent schedule creations ran alongside database transactions with row-level security (RLS) policies.
observedFailure: Lock contention and transaction deadlocks occurred during high-throughput schedule insertions.
fix: Hoisted non-RLS read operations outside the schedule creation transaction block.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that worker script execution operates cleanly without database lock contention.

generalizedConstraint: Hoisted non-RLS read operations outside the schedule creation transaction block.

title: Racing Child Task Status Updates Overwriting Operator DAG Status
assumption: Assumed DAG status updates emitted by child tasks could safely update the overall workflow run status.
trigger: Multiple child tasks in an operator DAG completed concurrently, racing to update the parent workflow status.
observedFailure: Inconsistent terminal states where intermediate child task statuses overwrote the orchestrator's decision.
fix: Restricted DAG status authority strictly to the orchestrator task and serialized updates via ordering constraints.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that operator DAG status transitions originate solely from orchestrator events rather than child tasks.

generalizedConstraint: Restricted DAG status authority strictly to the orchestrator task and serialized updates via ordering constraints.

title: Cross-Instance Event Delivery Due to Missing Scope Filtering in Durable Events
assumption: Assumed durable user event names were globally unique within a tenant without workflow scope filtering.
trigger: Two concurrent workflow instances waited on identically-named durable events.
observedFailure: Event delivery cross-matched and woke up the wrong workflow instance.
fix: Added explicit workflow run and step run scope identifiers to durable event matching queries.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that durable user event matches are strictly isolated to their target workflow and step run scopes.

generalizedConstraint: Added explicit workflow run and step run scope identifiers to durable event matching queries.

title: Child Spawn Key Collisions Breaking Downstream DAG Step Execution
assumption: Assumed user-spawned child workflows could share key namespaces with internal DAG step invocations.
trigger: A DAG step spawned child workflows using deterministic step identifiers that collided with user child spawns.
observedFailure: Downstream DAG steps broke because duplicate key suppression discarded valid step runs.
fix: Namespaced child spawn keys using distinct prefixes for internal DAG steps versus user-spawned workflows.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that child spawn key generator namespaces DAG step child workflows distinctly from user child spawns.

generalizedConstraint: Namespaced child spawn keys using distinct prefixes for internal DAG steps versus user-spawned workflows.

title: Starvation from Offset-Zero Reset on Equal Label Affinity Worker Ties
assumption: Assumed label ranking could reset the assignment ring offset to zero on every dispatch pass.
trigger: Multiple workers possessed equal affinity scores for a scheduled task.
observedFailure: Dispatcher packed all tasks onto the first worker in UUID order, causing hotspot starvation on other idle workers.
fix: Rotated the highest-ranked tied worker group to distribute tasks fairly across equal-affinity workers.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that scheduler round-robins task assignments across workers having equal label affinity scores.

generalizedConstraint: Rotated the highest-ranked tied worker group to distribute tasks fairly across equal-affinity workers.

title: Double Locking Overhead in Single-Task Workflow Concurrency Checks
assumption: Assumed single-task workflows required a distinct workflow-level concurrency gate separate from task concurrency.
trigger: Single-task workflows evaluated two separate concurrency locks in PostgreSQL during execution dispatch.
observedFailure: Double locking overhead and potential deadlocks under high-throughput single-task execution.
fix: Merged workflow-level concurrency limits directly onto the task definition for single-task workflows.

regressionTestProof.assertedBehavior: Asserts that single-task workflow concurrency configuration merges directly onto the task definition.

generalizedConstraint: Merged workflow-level concurrency limits directly onto the task definition for single-task workflows.
